leftEvidence.title: Jesus comes to John and speaks of fulfilling righteousness

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus comes from Galilee to be baptized; John resists, Jesus answers, and the baptism proceeds.
points.right: Immediately after the baptism, the Spirit leads Jesus into the wilderness where the tempter repeatedly challenges his sonship.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Opened heavens, descending Spirit, and a heavenly voice identify the beloved Son in whom God delights.
points.right: Jesus answers with Scripture; the devil leaves and angels serve him.

payload.posture: Matthew moves directly from the voice to challenges beginning “If you are the Son.”

rightEvidence.role: From Jordan into testing and proclamation
rightEvidence.title: The Spirit leads the beloved Son into testing

payload.tension: Divine declaration precedes testing; the testing does not create the sonship it challenges.
payload.title: Beloved Son and tested Son
